craft_notes: Sthāyin: definition — whole-pervasion (owner reviews first-verse of chapter). Sanskrit-first: vibhavātmaka kept whole; mahāsāmānya-kalpa as likeness. Rows: pervasion verdicts line-final. Rejected: modernizing pervasion — killed: technical term kept. Read aloud: opening span.

lines: This world-born glory, wombing endless enjoyers, enjoyed —
what runs through all as mighty light: the commonest Whole, high Śiva.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yad idaṃ vibhavātmakaṃ bhuvanajātam uktaṃ garbhīkṛtānantavicitrabhoktṛbhogyaṃ tatra yad anugataṃ mahāprakāśarūpaṃ tat mahāsāmānyakalpaṃ paramaśivarūpam

reads_against.argmap: Paramaśiva = what pervades as great light
